THE HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA: SHILLONG
NOTIFICATION
Dated Shillong the 24th September, 2026
No.HCM.11/184/2015-Estt/Pt./1 91 : In partial modification of Notification No. HCM
11/184/2015-Estt/Pt./191 dated 21.09.2026 and in view of administrative exigency & for better
administration of justice, the Hon’ble Full Court, High Court of Meghalaya vide its Resolution
dated 24th September, 2026, in exercise of powers under Rule 7 (C) (2) of the Rules of High
Court of Meghalaya, 2013 (as amended up to date), is pleased to transfer and post the
